verdict.rationale: Grok docs explicitly state built-in connectors let users connect email, files, and calendar directly in chat, authenticated via OAuth and maintained natively by xAI, plus broader connector support (e.g., Salesforce). No independent/hands-on confirmation of these specific connectors working in practice was found. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of cloud drive/email/calendar connectors actually working, and detail on which specific providers (Gmail, Google Drive, Outlook, etc.) are supported.
